text:
mia: Heads up — Bayleaf renewal at 90d. They want to shorten to a 6mo term with a seat true‑up. Onboarding still blocked by SSO/SAML verification. Need clarity on pricing concession and who signs the PO. Any updates?

jared: I pushed pricing proposal to the customer last week. They asked for 10% discount on the annual list but will accept 6mo if legal approves. No PO yet.

emily_legal: @jared send me the redline you showed them. If it's a 6mo term we need the limited warranty clause kept and the payment terms net30. I can fast track if doc is final.

mia: attached the pdf they uploaded to the portal — they circled the term and added a note about procurement timing. (link)

jared: thanks — sharing here: https://files.redwood/bayleaf/proposal_v3.pdf. Impact on ARR is small if we push midterm true‑up language.

emily_legal: if they sign a 6mo commit we add auto‑renew to 12mo unless they opt out 30d before renewal. That satisfies revenue recognition requirements.

sam_ops: SSO: their IdP metadata failed our last test (certificate mismatch). Waiting on their IT to rotate cert. Onboarding status: initial data ingest complete, feature enablement 2 of 5 tasks blocked by SAML.

mia: timeline ask from customer: they want go‑live within 3 weeks if we can confirm SSO and finalize contract. Procurement says they prefer PO over CC.

jared: asked buyer for PO template earlier. They said AP needs vendor code and invoice remit address. I can get a PO once legal signs.

emily_legal: I'll review and leave comments by EOD. If acceptable, give me a thumbs and I will route to signature.

docusign_bot: Envelope created: Bayleaf_Renewal_1738881234. Status: awaiting signature from Bayleaf procurement. Link: https://docusign.example/envelope/1738881234

mia: can someone confirm whether we can accept a PO with a different billing entity? customer asked about split invoicing across subsidiaries.

emily_legal: We can accept but need a billing addendum. I'll draft a one‑page addendum for split invoicing.

sam_ops: ops note — if billing entity differs from SSO domain we'll still proceed, but need the account mapping doc signed to route invoices correctly.

jared: I'll ping buyer for PO and ask for AP contact. Also asked IT for cert rotation ETA.

mia: thanks team. Plan: emily to finish legal redline by EOD, sam to confirm SSO ETA, jared to secure PO contact. I'll update customer and set expectation for 3‑week go‑live if all green. :white_check_mark:

emily_legal: got it, aiming to upload final by 1738881400.

sam_ops: their IT just replied — rotating cert tonight, will re‑test tomorrow morning.

jared: buyer confirmed they can issue PO once legal thumbs. AP contact: sara.k@bayleaf.com.

mia: perfect. I'll follow up with a calendar invite for a checkin tomorrow 10am PT.

docusign_bot: Envelope Bayleaf_Renewal_1738881234 updated: signer (Bayleaf procurement) viewed document.

emily_legal: uploaded final redline. Minor wording tweak on invoice remit.

jared: PO template received from Sara, forwarding to Mia.

mia: moving to close loop with customer. Will post final status here after tomorrow's call. :phone:
